jobs.title: AI-Driven Data Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on Data Architect
who thrives in an AI-first world – designing modern data platforms, leveraging AI-driven development
, and shaping how organizations turn data into intelligent action? Do you combine strong data engineering foundations with a software engineering mindset, and enjoy building, not just designing?

Here at Nortal, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing our data expertise and designing solutions
for our clients in Europe. You will work alongside top professionals in data and AI development
in Finland, collaborating with global data and software teams to design impactful solutions that drive business value.

What You'll Do

Design and implement AI-enabled data architectures and solutions on modern lakehouse platforms (Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks)
Apply AI-assisted and agent-driven design and development approaches to accelerate data platform and data product delivery
Combine data engineering, software engineering and DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD, testing, versioning, modular design)
Define and enforce data strategy, governance, standards and architectural guidelines
Work closely with technical and business teams to ensure alignment
Nurture a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing
Support pre-sales and solution design, contributing to customer engagements and proposals.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Experience in designing data architecture as part of enterprise architecture and data strategy
Familiarity with data mesh paradigm and principles
Knowledge of various data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouses
Experience with cloud and on-premise data solutions using Microsoft technologies, including strong hands-on work with Microsoft Fabric (preferred) or Databricks lakehouse platforms
Hands-on experience and/or strong understanding of working with agentic AI development and software delivery methodologies, e.g. agentic swarm coding and spec-driven development.
Experience applying software engineering practices (e.g. version control, CI/CD, testing) in data environments
Experience on hands-on software engineering & general software architecture design is a big plus
Pre-GenAI proficiency in Python and SQL
Fluent in both Finnish and English

We value the following certifications

Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
Databricks Data Engineer Associate or Professional
Azure Solutions Architect Expert

Why join Nortal?

We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing through our Capability teams, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Nortal’s offices are located in Helsinki, Turku, Oulu, Uusikaupunki, and Jyväskylä. This position can be worked from any of the previous, but we are pretty flexible with remote work as well.

Interested?

Apply here or contact our recruiter Virpi directly at virpi.kivinen(at)nortal.com

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We are hoping to get applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, language, culture or minority group.

jobs.title: Power Platform Developer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Tule mukaan Tieto Tech Consulting -tiimiin kasvamaan ympäristössä, jossa teknologia, liiketoimintamuotoilu ja yhteiskunnallinen vaikuttavuus kohtaavat.

Etsimme nyt Power Platform Developeria
tiimiin, jossa tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa ja merkityksellisissä projekteissa, jotka muovaavat toimialoja ja parantavat ihmisten arkea.

Mikä on Tech Consulting?

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen parhaat käytännöt.

Uskomme yhteistyöhön, avoimuuteen ja siihen, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät erilaisten ihmisten ja ajatusten kohdatessa.

Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta, kuten julkishallinto, finanssi-, eläke-, energia-, logistiikka- ja valmistava teollisuus. Kehitämme digitaalisia palveluita, joita ihmiset käyttävät päivittäin – ratkaisuja, joilla on todellista vaikutusta arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.

Mitä tulet tekemään tässä roolissa?

Tässä roolissa yrittäjähenkisyys ja oma-aloitteisuus ovat avainasemassa. Pääset rakentamaan roolistasi omanlaisesi osana tiimiämme, ja painopisteesi voi olla esimerkiksi myynnin tukemisessa, asiakasdialogissa, teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyssä, backlogien jalostamisessa tai jatkuvan parantamisen edistämisessä.

Työskentelemme usein funktioittain asiakkaiden sijaan, ja odotamme sinulta uusia näkökulmia sekä halua kehittää toimintatapojamme. Asiakastyössä autat ohjaamaan keskustelua pitkäjänteisen ja ketterän tuotekehityksen suuntaan sen sijaan, että keskityttäisiin pelkästään aikataulukysymyksiin.

Liityt tiimiin, jossa osaamisen jakaminen, yhteistyö ja asiakkaista huolehtiminen ovat vahvasti läsnä. Näkemystäsi arvostetaan, ja toivomme sinun olevan tärkeä osa yhteistä menestystämme!

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vähintään 2 vuoden kokemus Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta
Vahva osaaminen Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Copilot Studio)
Dynamics 365 -kokemus katsotaan eduksi
Power Platform / Dynamics -sertifikaatit plussaa
Kokemusta .NET- ja/tai React-kehityksestä sekä integraatioista
Kokemusta Azure Functions- ja Logic Apps -ratkaisuista sekä DevOps-ympäristöistä
Kokemusta tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä kehityksessä ja asiakasratkaisuissa
Hyvät viestintätaidot ja kyky selittää teknisiä ratkaisuja ei-teknisille sidosryhmille
Sujuva suomi ja englanti
Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietojenkäsittely, ohjelmistotekniikka)

Miksi liittyä kasvavaan tiimiimme?

Tiedolla rakennamme teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tech Consultingissa työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa.

Saat tueksesi Suomen laajimman IT-osaajaverkoston sekä kulttuurin, joka kannustaa yhteistyöhön, uteliaisuuteen ja jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Meillä kasvu ei pysähdy.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti kriittisten digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi eri toimialoilla, teknologioissa ja rooleissa
Joustavat työskentelytavat, hyvinvointia tukevat edut sekä inhimillisen työkulttuurin

Miten haet mukaan?

Lähetä hakemuksesi urasivujemme kautta ja tule mukaan rakentamaan Microsoft-ratkaisujen tulevaisuutta eri toimialoilla!

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele hakemuksia heinäkuun aikana. Palaamme rekrytointiprosessiin elokuun alussa, joten jätä hakemuksesi jo nyt, jotta ehdit mukaan hakuun!

Teemme turvallisuusselvityksen kaikille rekrytointiprosessin loppuvaiheeseen eteneville hakijoille.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: .NET Developers with Experience in Health Data, Clinical Systems or Public Healthcare Platforms
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
About Twoday

Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 technologists, we collaborate with some of the most recognised private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our deep industry expertise spans Data & AI, software development, digital experiences and business applications.

Our team operates across the Nordics and Lithuania, supporting more than 8,000 customers on their digital transformation journeys.

NET Developers with Experience in Health Data, Clinical Systems or Public Healthcare Platforms

Twoday is looking for both a Senior .NET Developer and a Junior .NET Developer (two to three years of relevant experience after your education) for a long-term public-sector healthcare project in Copenhagen.

You will join Twoday as a permanent employee and work closely with one of Denmark's most important public healthcare organisations on solutions that support healthcare professionals, health data and critical public services.

The role

You will contribute to the development, maintenance and modernisation of complex .NET solutions in a highly regulated environment.

Depending on your experience level, your responsibilities may include:

Developing and maintaining .NET-based applications and services
Designing and implementing integrations and APIs
Working with health data and business-critical workflows
Collaborating with architects, developers, product owners and stakeholders
Participating in code reviews, testing and quality assurance
Contributing to secure, maintainable and scalable solutions

Senior candidates are expected to take a larger role in technical decision-making, solution design and mentoring.

Required Experience

We are specifically looking for candidates with experience from one or more of the following areas:

Electronic Patient Record (EPR/EPJ) systems
Health data platforms
Clinical systems
Patient-related workflows
Healthcare authorities
Public healthcare platforms
Solutions used directly by healthcare professionals
Healthcare integrations and healthcare-related data flows

Experience from administrative solutions alone (e.g. workforce planning, payroll or HR systems for healthcare organisations) is not considered sufficient for this role.

Senior profile

You typically have:

Several years of experience with C# and .NET
Experience working with complex integrations and APIs
Experience from health data, clinical systems or public healthcare platforms
Strong understanding of software quality, maintainability and security
Experience working with stakeholders in larger organisations

Junior profile

You typically have:

Two to three years of professional software development experience after having completed your education
Experience with C# and .NET
Experience from health data, clinical systems or public healthcare platforms
Understanding of APIs, databases and modern development practices
Desire to develop further in a strong professional environment

Technical environment

Experience with some of the following is expected:

C# / .NET
REST APIs
SQL Server
Entity Framework
Azure DevOps
CI/CD
Integration development
Automated testing

Language Requirements

Fluent Danish, both written and spoken, is required.

Location

The role is primarily onsite in the Copenhagen area.

Why Twoday

At Twoday, you will join one of the leading digital transformation partners in the Nordics and become part of a strong professional community where knowledge sharing, collaboration and continuous development are central.

What We Offer

Permanent employment with Twoday
Opportunity to work on meaningful, high-impact public sector solutions
Professional development in a strong technical environment
A collaborative and supportive team culture

If you are interested in contributing to impactful healthcare solutions and working closely with a key public sector client, we would love to hear from you.

The process

Telephone interview with a Talent Acquisition Partner
Teams interview with hiring manager
Technical assessment
Onsite interview with hiring manager

About Twoday

Twoday has modern offices in more than 30 locations across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Lithuania. We offer an engaging work environment with high professional standards and a strong sense of community. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally in an international and innovative organisation.

Diversity & Inclusion

Don’t meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building an inclusive workplace, and we encourage you to apply if the role interests you – even if your experience does not match the job description perfectly.

jobs.description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Key Responsibilities

Application Performance Monitoring Observability:

Monitor critical applications using Cisco APM, and other observability tools to ensure performance and availability as part of BAU support.
Instrument, configure, and customize real user monitoring (RUM) agents for both web and mobile apps.
Analyze RUM data with query languages or BI tools to uncover insights and recommend improvements.
Utilize session-replay tools to diagnose user behavior and performance issues.
Develop custom queries and metrics to enhance visibility into key problem areas in customer environments.
Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, KPIs, and performance trend reports.
Support and maintain health of monitoring platforms, including regular patching and upgrades.
Create knowledge base articles, training materials for clients and internal teams.
Provide technical training to clients and mentoring to team members on performance monitoring best practices.
Collaborate with application developers and infrastructure teams for end-to-end performance troubleshooting and tuning.
Engage in incident response and troubleshooting for clients.
Participate in on-call rotations and flexible maintenance windows.

Required Skills Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency in full-stack monitoring and observability practices, including log tracing, metrics, and real-time dashboards.
Experience with modern technologies such as containers (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift), VMs, serverless functions, and CI/CD tools.
Good understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including networking, compute, storage, and security services.
Good foundation in networking, operating systems (Windows/Linux), servers, web applications, and databases (Oracle, MS SQL, DB2, etc).
At least 5+ years of experience implementation and support of Cisco APM, Dynatrace, Datadog or equivalent in enterprise environments.
Experience in DevOps engineering using web technologies (Java, Python, Ruby, Go, .NET, PHP, Angular, React, HTML, CSS).
Experience with mobile frameworks (Cordova, Flutter, React Native, Xamarin, .NET MAUI) development.
Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, processes, and troubleshooting steps.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document processes and technical solutions clearly and accurately.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.
Experience in WOG environments.
At least 5 years of hands-on experience with Cisco APM, Dynatrace, Datadog or equivalent (AppDynamics Certification preferred).
Certifications for the above will be highly advantageous.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

jobs.description:
Job Description

DSO National Laboratories (DSO) is Singapore’s largest defence research and development (R&D) organisation, with the critical mission to develop technological solutions to sharpen the cutting edge of Singapore's national security. At DSO, you will develop more than just a career. This is where you will make a real impact and shape the future of defence across the spectrum of air, land, sea, space and cyberspace.

The Emerging Systems Division focuses research and development on a broad spectrum of capabilities that are critical to the Singapore Armed Forces (SAF) defence systems. These include antenna design and electromagnetics, as well as next-wave technologies in the areas of lasers and advanced materials.

People are DSO’s greatest asset. You will get to realise your career aspirations and develop your own niche either as a deep technical expert or a leader in the team. With frequent career dialogues and a robust training and development framework, we will provide you with the necessary development tools for you to reach your potential. You will also be recognised and rewarded through competitive remuneration packages and scholarship opportunities.

Software Engineer (Emerging Systems)

In This Role, You Will

Elicit software requirements based on users' needs and design a safe and secure software architecture
Write code which implements the software requirements and design test cases to verify the code
Work closely with the hardware team to carry out integration tests, both in the lab and field

If you are passionate about software development and enjoy working in cutting edge technological fields, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and help shape the future of SAF technology today!

Job Requirements

Degree/ Masters in Computer Science/ Computing/ Computer Engineering/ Electrical Engineering
Experience with C/ C++/ C#/ Python programming languages
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
Open-minded and comfortable interacting with engineers from other disciplines
Interesting in exploring and developing a variety of software, from embedded software to GUI development

jobs.description:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Senior Software Engineer (.NET + Vue).

You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of professional software development experience.
Advanced English is required.
Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
Deep expertise in C# and .NET with extensive experience building production software.
Proven experience developing modern web applications with Vue, with strong React or Angular experience also considered.
Strong experience designing, deploying, and operating production systems on Microsoft Azure with a focus on scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.
Solid background working with SQL Server, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
Hands-on experience using Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools as a core part of the software engineering workflow.
Proven experience using AI tools for activities such as prototyping, code generation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and technical documentation.
Strong experience writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested production code.
Experience participating actively in code reviews and maintaining high engineering quality standards.
Strong collaboration skills and a product-minded approach, with experience partnering directly with Product, Design, and Customer Success.
Experience mentoring engineers and participating in pair programming or collaborative development.
Familiarity with CRM or other data-intensive platforms is a plus.
Experience with Datadog, Playwright, or similar observability and testing tools is a plus.
Experience with CI/CD and frequent production deployments is a plus.
Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
Forensic attention to detail.
A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.
Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

Competitive pay.
100% remote work.
The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
Continuing education opportunities.
Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

jobs.description:
Responsible for the analysis, development, customization, support, and maintenance of the company’s Infor Syteline ERP and related software platforms. The role will focus on Syteline customization, application development, integrations, troubleshooting, SQL Server/T-SQL, ERP upgrades, and collaboration with IT and business operations.

Key Responsabilities

Maintain, support, customize, and improve the Infor Syteline ERP and related software platforms.
Customize Syteline Forms and Reporting according to business requirements.
Develop new functionality and applications to support manufacturing operations.
Develop and maintain integrations and APIs with internal and third-party systems.
Work extensively with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL, including modifying existing code, adding fields, subqueries, and database enhancements.
Diagnose and resolve software and production issues.
Provide technical support to users.
Support ERP upgrades and future modernization initiatives.
Collaborate with the VP of IT, IT team, and business users to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Learn and apply new technologies and company-specific manufacturing processes.
Travel to the United States for initial onboarding/training and occasionally for project-based needs.

Profile Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Development, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of professional experience with Infor Syteline ERP.
Hands-on experience with Syteline Forms, Reporting, DataViews, and Event Handlers.
3+ years of professional experience with Microsoft .NET / C#.
3+ years of professional experience with Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL.
Strong technical problem-solving skills.
Bilingual English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
Experience with integrations/APIs is preferred.
Blazor / modern .NET experience is preferred.
Manufacturing experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Willingness and ability to travel to the United States for onboarding and training.

Soft Skills

Technical problem-solving
Analytical thinking
Independence and learning agility
Strong communication skills
Collaboration
Project management
Results orientation
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Identity & Access Management
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is negotiable, the range being $6,000-$11,000 per month (Gross in USD), based on location and experience level.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation
:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $6000 - $11000
per month, negotiable based on the skills and experience being brought to the table. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level.

This is a fully remote role
. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. You get principal-level scope and ownership at a growing fintech, competitive compensation, and no relocation or commute attached to it. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated best-in-class Principal Software Engineer to own and lead the evolution of authentication and authorization at Sezzle. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is investing in the next generation of its authentication and authorization platform, centered on a purpose-built API auth gateway and a clean set of identity and access management services. As the Principal Software Engineer leading this effort, you will own the technical vision, architecture, and migration strategy for this transformation.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Security, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with engineering teams across the organization to deliver auth capabilities that are safe, incremental to adopt, and invisible to customers. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering gateway and identity services, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates. Your work will generally focus on foundational platform capabilities, security-critical paths, and performance at the edge.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted development is a standard part of how we build, paired with the rigorous review and security discipline the auth-critical path demands. As a principal engineer, you will help set the pattern for how AI tooling is used well on security-sensitive systems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the technical vision and roadmap for Sezzle’s authentication and authorization platform, including a dedicated API auth gateway and supporting identity services.
Architect, design, and build scalable, highly-available auth services and gateway components primarily in Golang, leveraging AWS, RDS (MySQL/Postgres), and modern distributed patterns.
Design and lead phased, zero-downtime migrations of auth traffic and functionality, with clear rollback and safety mechanisms at every step.
Establish and evolve authentication and authorization standards across the platform: OAuth2/OIDC flows, token strategy (JWT, opaque, refresh), service-to-service auth (mTLS, workload identity), and fine-grained authorization models (RBAC/ABAC/policy engines).
Drive consistency and scalability across a distributed microservices architecture while maintaining the performance, reliability, and latency budgets expected of an edge gateway.
Partner with Security and Compliance to ensure the new platform meets fintech-grade security and regulatory requirements, and champion secure-by-default patterns across engineering.
Establish and evolve engineering best practices for observability, security, and CI/CD across teams, with particular rigor on the auth-critical path.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own, and help lead incident response and postmortems on the auth-critical path.
Mentor engineers and champion a culture of learning, innovation, and operational excellence.
Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliver results that matter.

Minimum Requirements:

12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
Deep, hands-on expertise in authentication and authorization systems: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT and session-based auth, token lifecycle management, and modern authorization patterns (RBAC, ABAC, policy-as-code).
Experience designing, building, or operating an API gateway or auth proxy at scale: whether a commercial/open-source gateway (e.g., Kong, Envoy, AWS API Gateway, Traefik) or an in-house edge service.
Proven track record leading a large-scale service extraction or migration: decomposing a monolith or large legacy service into well-bounded services with zero or minimal customer impact.
Strong proficiency in Golang, with experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs.
Expertise with SQL-based RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and experience optimizing schema and queries for performance at scale.
Solid understanding of distributed systems design patterns (e.g., transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, queues) and the specific challenges of high-throughput, low-latency edge services.
Demonstrated ability to bring new ideas forward, influence decisions, and lead complex technical initiatives across many teams.
Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and help teammates adopt AI-assisted workflows.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required).

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

Experience with identity platforms and standards implementations (e.g., Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, Ory, or in-house IdPs), and familiarity with fine-grained authorization approaches (policy-as-code, relationship-based access control) as we centralize authorization over time.
Experience with service mesh and edge technologies (Envoy, Istio, mTLS, rate limiting, WAF integration).
Familiarity with threat modeling, secure design review, and common auth attack vectors (token theft, replay, CSRF, session fixation, privilege escalation).
Proficiency in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic), especially for latency-sensitive edge services.
Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, mainly AWS Aurora RDS, both MySQL and Postgres.
Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending - familiarity with financial compliance (PCI-DSS, SOC 2), credit decisioning, or transaction processing systems.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized microservices (Docker, Kubernetes).
Track record of shipping commercial APIs and platform infrastructure in high-growth environments.
Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling engineering organizations.

About You:

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
Backend: Golang
Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
Version Control: Git
CI/CD: Gitlab
Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.title: Platform Architect (Azure, DevOps & AI)
jobs.description:
Volg je liever een uitgestippeld pad, of krijg je graag de ruimte om op jouw manier zaken uit te bouwen?

Bij 9altitudes vormt ons interne platform de basis waarop R&D, go-to-market en onze eigen consultants dagelijks bouwen. Het moet betrouwbaar, goed beheerd en klaar zijn voor wat morgen brengt. En wat morgen brengt, is meer en meer AI.

Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze Azure-omgeving stevig staat, onze DevOps-processen performant blijven en onze internationale organisatie AI-oplossingen adopteert op basis van inzicht en meerwaarde, niet op basis van hype.

Vanaf dag één krijg je ownership. Niet pas nadat je jezelf hebt bewezen. Je denkt vooruit, neemt initiatief en staat achter de oplossingen die je realiseert.

Je dagelijkse avontuur

Je bent de technische eigenaar van de platformen die onze organisatie draaiende houden én klaarstomen voor de toekomst. Van Azure-governance en DevOps-automatisering tot AI-adoptie en platformkwaliteit: jij bouwt de fundamenten waarop teams binnen 9altitudes sneller, slimmer en met vertrouwen kunnen werken.

Cloud & platform operations (Azure)

Beheren en governen van onze Azure-subscripties voor R&D, go-to-market en interne systemen, inclusief kostenbeheer, capaciteit en toegangsbeheer.
Uitbouwen en opvolgen van geavanceerde monitoringoplossingen.
Zorgen voor een betrouwbaar en performant applicatielandschap.

DevOps & CI/CD

Ontwerpen, onderhouden en verbeteren van DevOps-pipelines en GitHub Actions-workflows.
Build-, test- en releaseprocessen standaardiseren over verschillende solution areas heen, zodat teams sneller kunnen schakelen met minder verrassingen.

AI enablement & governance

Ontwikkelen en beheren van het AI Usage Reporting Portal.
Richting geven aan de adoptie van AI-tools (zoals Claude Code, GitHub Copilot en toekomstige oplossingen) en deze vertalen naar duidelijke aanbevelingen en interne richtlijnen.

D365 platform & quality (FO/CE)

Uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles en technische opvolging van onze interne Dynamics 365-omgevingen (FSCM & CE). Diepgaande functionele kennis is geen vereiste; inzicht in architectuur, governance en ALM is een grote meerwaarde.
Ondersteunen van integraties en bewaken van de kwaliteit van releases.

Go-to-market tenant, release management & advisory

Beheren van de GTM-tenant en optimaliseren van de processen eromheen, zoals publicatie van release notes, testframeworks en andere ondersteunende processen.
Actief bijdragen aan onze internationale technische Centers of Excellence.

Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen operationele taken en een adviserende rol, soms zelfs op dezelfde dag.

Die afwisseling is geen afleiding van de job. Ze ís de job.

Vaardigheden

Must-have

Microsoft Azure: subscription governance, cost management en monitoring.
CI/CD: Azure DevOps Pipelines en GitHub Actions. Ervaring met PowerShell- en YAML-scripting. Kennis van Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep/ARM).
Microsoft 365 en Entra ID: identity-, access- en tenantmanagement.
Affiniteit met AI-tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) en de onderliggende technologieën (zoals MCP en vergelijkbare concepten), aangevuld met inzicht in AI-gebruik en kostenbeheer.

Nice-to-have

Kennis van Dynamics 365 (F&SCM en/of CE) op platformniveau.
Governance binnen het Power Platform.
Gebruikers- en applicatietoegangsbeheer (Azure Key Vault, Devolutions) en Intune- of endpointbeheer.
Ervaring binnen een Microsoft-partner- of consultancyomgeving.

Als persoon ben je

Veelzijdig en voel je je comfortabel in zowel operationele als strategisch adviserende opdrachten.
Zelfstandig, pragmatisch en hands-on. Je neemt ownership en zet door tot er een oplossing is.
Gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht. Je documenteert, standaardiseert en deelt kennis om duurzame en herbruikbare meerwaarde te creëren.
Servicegericht en communicatief sterk. Je bouwt relaties op met interne stakeholders en vertaalt technische onderwerpen naar heldere adviezen.
Nieuwsgierig en leergierig. Je volgt de ontwikkelingen rond cloud, DevOps en (agentic) AI actief op.

Je travelpack wordt gevuld met

Vertrouwen vanaf dag één. Echt ownership over een platform dat ertoe doet, met de autonomie om mee te bepalen hoe het evolueert.
Groeikansen in de richting die bij jou past: diepere technische expertise, een bredere scope of een internationale rol binnen onze groep. Op jouw tempo en volgens jouw ambities.
Sterke lokale teams waarop je kunt bouwen, ondersteund door een internationale organisatie die je horizon verruimt.
Een unieke inkijk in hoe een Microsoft-partner AI daadwerkelijk adopteert, én inspraak in hoe die in de toekomst vorm krijgt.
Een verloningspakket dat aansluit bij jouw impact: een competitief salaris, aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen en de flexibiliteit om een deel van je pakket af te stemmen op wat voor jou belangrijk is.

Trusted Advisor

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Mission

Gorilla is the margin intelligence platform for energy retailers. We help some of the largest energy companies in UK, Europe, the US, and Australia understand where they make and lose money, from portfolio level down to individual customer contracts.

We are entering a phase where protecting and growing our existing customer base matters as much as winning new logos. Our annual renewals represent millions in recurring revenue, and every one of them is an opportunity to deepen the relationship, expand into new modules, and prove the compounding value of our platform.

About The Role

As a QA Engineer, you’ll play a key role in ensuring our data platform meets the highest standards of reliability and performance. Our SaaS platform empowers energy retailers with data processing at scale, from pricing and forecasting to complex analytics. You’ll work closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to build confidence in our product by embedding testing early in the development cycle and ensuring smooth, reliable releases.

You’ll be the advocate for quality and the critical link between feature development, user feedback, and product delivery.

Responsibilities

Define the testing scope and plan, and execute test cases across features and sprints.
Report on test coverage and product stability for each sprint/release to support go/no-go decisions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, review acceptance criteria, and provide feedback early in the process.
Identify and communicate risks that could impact product quality.
Act as a bridge between the product, support, and internal user teams by collecting feedback, troubleshooting bugs, and performing root cause analysis.
Automate acceptance tests using our existing test frameworks.
Conduct exploratory testing, and run regression and performance tests (automated where possible).
Promote good QA practices and foster a quality-first mindset within development teams.
Document issues clearly with reproducible steps and supporting artifacts (logs, screenshots, etc.).
Perform peer reviews on both manual and automated test cases.

What You'll Bring

Minimum 3 years of experience as a Tester in an Agile development environment.
Proficiency in both manual and automated testing, including test planning, design, and execution.
Strong knowledge of web-based applications and testing web service APIs.
Hands-on experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright (+), Cypress, Selenium, WebDriverIO, Appium, or JMeter.
A methodical and curious mindset, with a strong eye for detail.
Passion for continuous learning and staying current with QA best practices.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills in English.
Openness to give and receive feedback regularly.

What's In It For You

Flexible ways of working – We’re a hybrid-first company, with offices designed for collaboration and connection. Where there isn’t a Gorilla office nearby or regular travel to an office isn’t practical, we support remote working. From day one, you'll be equipped with the best laptop for your role, so you have everything you need to do your best work. Note that semi-frequent travel is required for this role, across Europe and beyond.
At Gorilla, we don't just watch the energy transition happen, we help make it viable. We build the intelligence layer that lets energy retailers see, steer, and protect their margins, giving them the financial clarity and operational room to invest confidently in renewables, storage, and flexibility. It's serious work with real impact on a cleaner energy system, and we have some fun along the way.
Core Benefits - Wherever your location, you can expect a generous PTO allowance and health insurance coverage.
At Gorilla, you'll work with genuinely sharp people on hard problems that matter. As we build the category leader in Energy Margin Intelligence, there's real room to leave your mark and grow your scope alongside the company. Lifelong learning is part of our DNA, and we care about your individual dreams and ambitions, beyond just work.
Regular company off-sites: We host Gorilla Company-Wide Gatherings where we all get a chance to see each other in real life. Past locations have included Belgium, Portugal, the Netherlands, and Spain.

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer - NL
jobs.description:
Functiebeschrijving

Als Test Automation Engineer ondersteun je ontwikkelteams door het opzetten en onderhouden van test automation frameworks en test scripts.

Je creeërt en beheert testscripts voor functionele, regressie- en performantietesten. Je ontwikkelt een testplan en staat garant voor de kwaliteit in je testopdracht.

Je zorgt ervoor dat de geautomatiseerde testen naadloos worden geïntegreerd in de Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, zodat nieuwe software-updates continu en betrouwbaar kunnen worden getest.

Het analyseren van testresultaten is een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk. Je beoordeelt de testuitkomsten nauwkeurig en je rapporteert je bevindingen aan het ontwikkelingsteam. Hierdoor kunnen eventuele problemen snel worden geïdentificeerd en opgelost, wat bijdraagt aan de stabiliteit en kwaliteit van de software.

Daarnaast werk je intensief samen met ontwikkelaars, QA-specialisten en andere belanghebbenden. Door gezamenlijk teststrategieën te verbeteren en best practices toe te passen, zorg je ervoor dat de softwareproducten voldoen aan hoge kwaliteitsnormen en optimaal presteren.

Profiel

Je behaalde een bachelor in de informatica of een gelijkwaardige expertise. Je hebt eveneens een eerste ervaring in het testdomein.

Je voert geautomatiseerde testen uit op SOAP & REST-services en hebt ervaring met Java en SQL. Je werkt met tools zoals Selenium, Cucumber en Postman en bij voorkeur ook met JUnit, Lombok, XML en IDE’s. Ervaring met versiebeheer is een troef.

Verder ben je vertrouwd met het werken in een Agile omgeving en volgens Agile methodologie.

Tevens heb je een goede kennis van cloud platforms.

Je certificering in ISTQB Foundation en ISTQB Certified Test Automation Engineer is een uitgesproken troef.

Je beschikt over een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen en weet technische uitdagingen snel en doeltreffend te analyseren en op te lossen.

Dankzij je analytisch denkvermogen ben je in staat softwaregedrag en testresultaten grondig te evalueren en hieruit waardevolle inzichten te halen.

Daarnaast heb je goede communicatieve vaardigheden. Zo weet je effectief te communiceren met je verschillende belanghebbenden binnen een project.

Je hebt een goede kennis van het Frans en het Engels.

Wij bieden

Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job
waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.
Zoek je een goede balans tussen werk en privéleven? Geniet van flexibele werkuren en maak gebruik van ons zeer uitgebreid telewerkbeleid
.
We bieden ruime interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor je je technische skills en persoonlijke vaardigheden voortdurend kunt aanscherpen.
We bieden je een competitief salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer .NET
jobs.description:
About Us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain complex software components that align with business and technical requirements. You will take ownership of feature implementation, troubleshoot technical challenges, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. Your role will involve contributing to technical discussions, refining best practices, and supporting junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing. Your expertise in programming and software engineering will be essential for achieving project goals and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products.

This role is based in Madrid.

What will you be doing?

Contribute to system architecture discussions and develop software components aligned with functional and non-functional requirements.
Creating high-quality, maintainable code in accordance with company best practices and standards.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and optimization to ensure performance, scalability, and reliability.
Develop and maintain cloud-based APIs, microservices, and integrations as part of a collaborative engineering team.
Support junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and sharing technical insights.
Collaborate with the team to refine task prioritization and align work with project goals.
Tackling complex problems requiring deep analysis and evaluation of diverse factors.
Collaborating closely with other teams and departments, such as product teams to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements.
Communicate effectively with team members and external stakeholders to clarify requirements and share progress updates.
Participate in technical discussions, advocate for improvements, and help resolve disagreements constructively.
Providing timely, concise, and actionable feedback to team colleagues.
Share knowledge through documentation, workshops, or informal team sessions.
Assist in technical interviews to evaluate candidates for your team.
Maintaining openness to communication with both local and external partners.
Proactively learn new tools and practices (e.g., DevOps, cloud services) to expand technical expertise.

What are we looking for?

Experience in designing and developing advanced software systems.
Proficiency in object-oriented programming concepts, algorithms, and data structures.
Continuous focus on enhancing skills in software architecture design, and product development.
Strong orientation toward task automation to save time and effort.
Implementation of improvements and optimizations in daily operations.
Planning and managing complex multi-system deployments without impacting client operations.
Ability to balance the demands of delivering high-quality software within tight deadlines.
Programming across multiple languages (C#, JavaScript, Java in plus).
Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Expertise in cloud infrastructure automation.
Knowledge and experience in use of design patterns
Fluency in English is required for this role.

The tech stack

C# .NET - Required
RDBMS / SQL - Required
TypeScript - Preferred
Javascript - Preferred
Amazon Web Services - Required

What do we offer?

💸 Clear and transparent compensation plan.
The salary range goes from 47,000 € to 68,000 €
. We will discuss the indicated range with you in the first recruiting call to ensure that we are on the same page.

💰 Flexible salary benefits

Save on personal income tax with Cobee for expenses like transport, restaurants, and kindergarten.

🩺 Private health insurance

Free for all employees via Cigna
, plus we cover 50% for your family members
.

🌅 Generous time off

Enjoy 26 days of holiday per year
(23 base days + your 🎂 birthday off
, Christmas Eve, and New Year’s Eve).

💻 Your gear, your choice

Whether you prefer Mac or Windows
, or need an extra screen, we’ll make sure you’re set up for success from day one.

🗓️ Annual Salary Review

We’re committed to recognizing your professional growth. Every year, we review salaries to reflect your individual development, achievements, and impact on our business success.

📙 Grow your skills

We offer up to €2000/year
in training (certifications, conferences, workshops) to boost your growth—both technical and personal.

📺 Learning resources

Access internal and external training
, including platforms like LinkedIn Learning
, completely free.

🧘‍♂️ Holistic wellness program

Includes access to Wellhub, Curalinc (psychological support), Rocketlawyer (legal advice), and regular health webinars & challenges.

😊 Volunteer day

Take one day off a year
to volunteer and give back. Bonus points for sharing pics on Slack!

👩‍⚕️ Free therapy vouchers

Because your mental health matters.

🏐 Health & wellness support

Get up to €55/month
to cover your gym or fitness classes (yoga, boxing, pilates, etc.).

🗺️ Weekly language classes

Improve or learn a new language (English, Spanish, French, Italian, or German) in small groups with expert instructors—on us!

🏥 Time for health

Get 8 hours per year
for personal medical appointments and 10 hours per year
to support your family’s medical needs.

⚖️ Work-life balance

We’re flexible and people-first. We know life happens, and we aim to make work work for you.

💜 Inclusive, upbeat culture

No suits here—just a welcoming, casual, and respectful space where diversity is celebrated
, and you can be your full self.

🌍 A global, multicultural team

We’re made up of 20+ nationalities
, speaking 10+ languages
. All communication is in English, so everyone’s included.

📦 Packlink Pro discount

Enjoy 99% off
your personal shipments using our platform.

🔗 Referral bonuses

Know someone amazing? Earn €1K–€3K
when you refer candidates we hire—depending on the role.

🏢 Central Madrid office

When you want a change of scenery, drop by our office in the heart of Madrid— free snacks and drinks included
!

🏟️ Team events

We work hard and play hard with regular team-building activities and meetups.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - .NET, Vue.js and Cursor
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend lean
to join the team that builds and evolves the platform powering this experience. You will work on the Research Topic Management (RTM)
application — a distributed .NET system with Vue/Nuxt frontends, SQL Server-heavy data operations, Github/Azure DevOps-driven deployments, and async integration workflows connecting multiple internal services.

This is a senior role where autonomy, ownership, and technical leadership
are central. You will own complex backend systems and full-stack features end-to-end — from specification refinement and architectural decisions, through implementation, to production monitoring and incident resolution. You will work on real production systems where SQL performance, distributed reliability, and integration correctness matter daily.

We have fully embraced AI-based spec-driven design
, integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle — using skills, rules, multi-agent workflows, and automation for code review, testing, and code analysis. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate, making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn't an experiment. It's how we work.

Your work directly enables researchers worldwide to collaborate, publish openly, and push science forward.

Science advances fastest when researchers can collaborate across boundaries — institutional, geographic, and disciplinary. Research Topics
are how Frontiers makes that happen.

Each Research Topic is a themed collection of peer-reviewed articles built around an emerging or critical area of science. Leading researchers from around the world propose a theme, invite contributors, and curate the resulting work — transforming scattered individual efforts into a coherent, openly accessible body of knowledge. When complete, every collection is published as a free ebook, available to anyone, anywhere.

These are not just publications. They are communities of researchers working together toward answers that matter: healthier lives, a more sustainable planet, a deeper understanding of the world we share.

The Research Topic Management (RTM)
application is the platform that makes this possible at scale. It supports the full lifecycle — from the moment a researcher proposes a topic, through editorial coordination, contributor recruitment, and submission tracking, all the way to publication and closure. RTM gives the teams behind Frontiers the tools they need to turn a scientific idea into open, lasting knowledge — one collection at a time.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities
:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET, Vue.js, and Nuxt
Modernise and replace legacy systems — including migrating older Angular applications to our current Vue and Nuxt stack
Own full-stack projects end-to-end, from specification refinement through delivery to production monitoring
Collaborate with product managers, architects, and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and determine the best implementation strategy
Work effectively within a multinational, cross-functional team to deliver software aligned with business needs
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, and uphold engineering best practices across the team
Ensure the quality of delivered solutions through robust testing and review
Optimise applications for performance, scalability, and responsiveness
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges across distributed systems
Leverage AI tooling to raise the quality, speed, and consistency of engineering work
Stay current with emerging technologies and bring fresh thinking to keep our stack modern
Maintain a business-oriented mindset, focused on delivering measurable outcomes for end-users

Required Skills and Experience
:

5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in .NET Core / .NET Framework
3+ years of hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (Vue 3 a plus) — and a solid command of the fundamentals: JavaScript, CSS, and HTML are a must
Strong expertise in Vue.js (Vue 2 and Vue 3), with a solid grasp of state management, component-based architecture, and best practices for building scalable front-end applications
Strong expertise in SQL Server: performance tuning, indexing strategies, query optimisation, and troubleshooting production issues
Extensive experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Experience or strong interest in applying AI to product features and engineering workflows
Experience owning complex, distributed system architectures
Solid understanding of microservices and micro-frontend concepts
Comfortable working in Kanban
Collaborative, with proven autonomy and ownership, and able to thrive in a hybrid environment

Nice-to-Have Skills
:

Experience with Nuxt
Experience with GraphQL (strong SQL knowledge transfers well here)
Experience with NoSQL databases
Experience with RabbitMQ and/or Kafka
Experience with containerization platforms (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps)

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

About This Role

Your team

The Investments and Trading Engineering (ITE) team builds and delivers Aladdin’s risk management, portfolio management, compliance, and trading capabilities. Within ITE, Quantitative Analytics Engineering (QAE) is a global team of quantitative developers responsible for implementing security valuation, portfolio risk, liquidity, and performance attribution models. BlackRock portfolio managers and external Aladdin clients, including pension funds and insurance companies, rely on these models to identify investment opportunities, build portfolios, and manage risk.

Security Analytics Infrastructure (SAI) is an established QAE team with colleagues in Hungary, New York, India, and Switzerland. The team develops scalable, high-throughput, low-latency analytical software in close partnership with Aladdin Financial Engineering, supporting the valuation of fixed-income products such as swaps, bonds, private credit, and derivatives. We challenge established approaches, adopt modern engineering practices, and bring together diverse perspectives to deliver reliable analytical capabilities. Our primary programming languages are C++ and Python.

Your role and impact

As a Director in Quantitative Engineering based in Budapest, you will help shape the next generation of our single-security analytical modeling platform using C++23 and Python 3. Working with colleagues across Europe, India, and the United States, you will influence the strategic development of analytical services in Aladdin and improve how investment analytics are delivered at scale.

You will combine hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership to understand business processes, identify bottlenecks, and optimize cloud-compute performance. You will lead complex implementations across scalable, modular, and distributed architectures while partnering with users, stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate business and client needs into reliable production solutions. The analytical models supported by the team are central to investment and risk-management workflows, making their scalable and dependable delivery a high-impact, cross-team responsibility.

Your responsibilities

Responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

Design and build the next generation of the single-security analytical modeling platform using C++23 and Python 3, collaborating with colleagues across Europe, India, and the United States.
Influence the strategic development of analytical services in Aladdin by understanding business processes, identifying bottlenecks, and improving cloud-compute performance.
Develop modules, applications, APIs, and observability pipelines that provide clients with new ways to access and use analytics.
Lead complex implementations and translate technical and business requirements into maintainable solutions using scalable, modular, and distributed architectures.
Engage with users, stakeholders, and teams responsible for external client requirements to understand their needs and shape effective solutions.
Partner with teams across BlackRock to understand supported business use cases and determine how they can be delivered more efficiently on a modern platform.
Promote quality through agile delivery, automated testing, effective engineering practices, clean code, and a focus on scalable and reliable analytical services.

Your experience

10+ years of experience in enterprise software development, including ownership of production services, platforms, or distributed systems.
Deep knowledge of software architecture, service design, APIs, data modeling, concurrency, and distributed systems.
Ability to mentor other engineers, lead ambiguous cross-functional initiatives, and deliver maintainable production systems with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency in C++17 or later and Python 3, supported by knowledge of design patterns, object-oriented design principles, algorithms, and data structures.
Familiarity with software testing, version control, continuous integration, C++ development tools such as CMake, Ninja, ccache, and distcc, Google Protocol Buffers, Unix systems, profiling tools, Azure DevOps, scripting with bash or PowerShell, Microsoft SQL, and enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling.
Familiarity with agentic development principles and knowledge of finance or fixed-income asset types are beneficial but not required. We will support you in developing the relevant financial knowledge.

The salary range for Hungary is 32400000 - 46700000 HUF

Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. Career Growth, Your Way Start your journey in a team that invests in your development: access to structured training on GenAI, hands-on mentoring, and clear growth paths from junior developer to more advanced technical roles.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - ERP Developer (Microsoft BC)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission
and what we offer
.

Introduction

We're looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our team and take on a critical role in optimizing and extending our Microsoft Business Central (BC) environment. In this high-impact position, you will contribute to the configuration, customization, and integration of BC to support seamless business operations. You'll play a key role in building robust integrations with third-party applications, managing the underlying infrastructure, and leading our migration to the cloud-based version of BC. If you have hands-on experience with BC development, enjoy solving complex integration challenges, and are passionate about delivering scalable enterprise solutions, we want to hear from you.

This role is ideal for a strong full-stack engineer with expertise in ERP systems, particularly Microsoft Business Central, who thrives on tweaking configurations, deploying updates, and ensuring reliable data flows across our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Configure, customize, and extend Microsoft Business Central using AL (Application Language) or C/AL, including building and maintaining custom pages, reports, and extensions to meet business needs.
Design, develop, and deploy integrations between Business Central and third-party applications via APIs (e.g., OData web services, REST APIs), enabling data synchronization for workflows like inventory, finance, and CRM.
Manage and optimize the Microsoft SQL Server database that powers Business Central, ensuring data integrity, performance tuning, high availability, and compliance with best practices.
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for efficient deployment, testing, and versioning of BC customizations and extensions.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver solutions that enhance operational efficiency.
Lead the planning and execution of our migration from on-premises Business Central to the cloud (SaaS) version, including data migration, configuration transfer, and minimal downtime strategies.
Uphold security, reliability, and monitoring standards for BC environments, including role-based access, audit trails, and proactive issue resolution.
Participate in on-call rotations as needed to support production systems and contribute to process improvements for faster incident response.

Qualifications

Requirements

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Business Central development, including configuration, extension building, and customization using AL/C/AL.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server management, including querying, indexing, backup/recovery, and performance optimization.
Expertise in CI/CD practices and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, PowerShell scripting) for deploying and managing BC updates and extensions.
Proven track record in building API-based integrations (RESTful, SOAP, OData) with third-party systems, such as Salesforce, Shopify, or custom apps.
A strong product mindset with a focus on user experience, including designing intuitive extensions and workflows within BC.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to break down complex problems into actionable milestones that deliver quick value.
Curiosity and drive for continuous learning, especially around Microsoft ecosystem updates and cloud technologies.
Familiarity with ERP concepts and business processes (e.g., finance, supply chain) is essential.

Qualifications

We recognize that few candidates will have every skill listed, and we're committed to supporting your growth. If you meet most of these and are excited to dive deeper into Business Central, we'd love to talk!

Nice-to-Haves

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 integrations or other ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
Knowledge of cloud migration strategies for Business Central, including Azure-based deployments and hybrid setups.
Proficiency in Power Platform tools (e.g., Power Automate, Power BI) for enhancing BC workflows.
Background in agile methodologies and version control with Git.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

new_jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer - NL
new_jobs.description:
Functiebeschrijving

Als Test Automation Engineer ondersteun je ontwikkelteams door het opzetten en onderhouden van test automation frameworks en test scripts.

Je creeërt en beheert testscripts voor functionele, regressie- en performantietesten. Je ontwikkelt een testplan en staat garant voor de kwaliteit in je testopdracht.

Je zorgt ervoor dat de geautomatiseerde testen naadloos worden geïntegreerd in de Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, zodat nieuwe software-updates continu en betrouwbaar kunnen worden getest.

Het analyseren van testresultaten is een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk. Je beoordeelt de testuitkomsten nauwkeurig en je rapporteert je bevindingen aan het ontwikkelingsteam. Hierdoor kunnen eventuele problemen snel worden geïdentificeerd en opgelost, wat bijdraagt aan de stabiliteit en kwaliteit van de software.

Daarnaast werk je intensief samen met ontwikkelaars, QA-specialisten en andere belanghebbenden. Door gezamenlijk teststrategieën te verbeteren en best practices toe te passen, zorg je ervoor dat de softwareproducten voldoen aan hoge kwaliteitsnormen en optimaal presteren.

Profiel

Je behaalde een bachelor in de informatica of een gelijkwaardige expertise. Je hebt eveneens een eerste ervaring in het testdomein.

Je voert geautomatiseerde testen uit op SOAP & REST-services en hebt ervaring met Java en SQL. Je werkt met tools zoals Selenium, Cucumber en Postman en bij voorkeur ook met JUnit, Lombok, XML en IDE’s. Ervaring met versiebeheer is een troef.

Verder ben je vertrouwd met het werken in een Agile omgeving en volgens Agile methodologie.

Tevens heb je een goede kennis van cloud platforms.

Je certificering in ISTQB Foundation en ISTQB Certified Test Automation Engineer is een uitgesproken troef.

Je beschikt over een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen en weet technische uitdagingen snel en doeltreffend te analyseren en op te lossen.

Dankzij je analytisch denkvermogen ben je in staat softwaregedrag en testresultaten grondig te evalueren en hieruit waardevolle inzichten te halen.

Daarnaast heb je goede communicatieve vaardigheden. Zo weet je effectief te communiceren met je verschillende belanghebbenden binnen een project.

Je hebt een goede kennis van het Frans en het Engels.

Wij bieden

Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job
waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.
Zoek je een goede balans tussen werk en privéleven? Geniet van flexibele werkuren en maak gebruik van ons zeer uitgebreid telewerkbeleid
.
We bieden ruime interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor je je technische skills en persoonlijke vaardigheden voortdurend kunt aanscherpen.
We bieden je een competitief salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen
zoals hospitalisatieverzekering, aanvullend pensioenplan, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques,… IT-functies kunnen rekenen op een mobiliteitsbudget
met de keuze voor een bedrijfswagen en/of terugbetaling openbaar vervoer. Onder bepaalde voorwaarden kan je dit budget zelfs gebruiken voor de betaling van je huur of hypothecaire lening.
Via ons 'Benefits at Work'-platform geniet je van mooie kortingen op mode, elektronica, daguitstappen, vakantieverblijven, …
We voeren een gelijkekansenbeleid
en vinden o.a. equal pay belangrijk.
